verdict.rationale: Gitleaks-Action integrates with GitHub Actions and explicitly calls the GitHub PR review-comment API to surface findings directly on pull requests, plus supports failure statuses that act as checks. However, there's no evidence of any GitLab equivalent (merge request comments/checks) — only GitHub is covered. Missing for 10: GitLab MR comment/check integration, and documentation of native GitHub Checks API status (vs just PR comments).
